subject: Yoruba
examFormat: The syllabus aims to prepare candidates for the UTME and tests their achievement of the objectives to stimulate and sustain interest in Yorùbá language, literature and culture, and to acquire basic knowledge and skill in Yorùbá language, literature and material and non-material aspects of culture. The test is objective: 40 multiple-choice questions covering Language (comprehension, 1 prose and 1 verse, 8 items; essay writing 1; sound system 4; grammar 5; current orthography 2; translation 1), Literature (oral 4, written 6) and Culture (9).
excluded: Diacritics in the extracted text were detached from their letters; Yorùbá headings and titles were reassembled with standard tone marks from context, so a few marks may differ from the printed syllabus.

topics.name: Comprehension
objectives: identify central issues in a passage and draw appropriate conclusions
determine basic assumptions and express ideas
identify the meanings and functions of given phrases and sentences
topics.content: One prose and one verse passage (8 items).

subtopics.name: Prose (comprehension)
Verse (comprehension)

topics.name: Essay Writing
objectives: identify different types of essay
apply different types of techniques associated with each type
topics.content: Argumentative, descriptive, narrative and letter writing (formal and informal) etc.

topics.name: Sound System
objectives: identify organs of speech, speech sounds and parameters for describing each speech sound
determine their correct usages
detect linguistic errors (pronunciations and wrong usages)
determine the syllable components of words
demonstrate knowledge of the basic principles underlying the relationship between sounds
topics.content: Production of sounds (consonants and vowels); tones and tone change; syllable structure; sound processes: co-vowel occurrence, elision, deletion, etc.

topics.name: Grammar
objectives: demonstrate good knowledge of word derivation
demonstrate knowledge of word adoption
identify the appropriate class a word belongs to
demonstrate knowledge and understanding of Yorùbá syntax
identify the types, structures and functions of sentences

subtopics.name: Morphology and word-formation
Loan-word integration
Word classes (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, pronouns, conjunctions, prepositions, etc.)
Phrases and clauses: types and functions
Sentences: types, structures and functions

topics.name: Current Orthography
objectives: present ideas in acceptable written form

topics.name: Translation
objectives: interpret sentences and ideas in accordance with acceptable principles

topics.name: Oral Literature
topics.content: Prescribed texts for oral literature (prose and drama).

subtopics.name: Àkójọpọ̀ Àlọ́ Ìjàpá (Apá Kejì) (Babalọlá, A., 2023) — Oral Prose (Ìtàn Àròsọ)
objectives: identify central issues, problems and the component parts of ideas presented in the work of art
draw moral lessons from the text
identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the text
draw appropriate conclusions

subtopics.name: Eégún Aláré (Ògúnníran, L., 2022) — Oral Drama (Eré Oníṣe)
objectives: identify the type of drama
extract the narrative techniques in the drama
identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the drama
identify the central theme of the work
interpret the central theme in accordance with acceptable principles of the society

topics.name: Written Literature
topics.content: Prescribed texts for written literature. For the poetry text Èdè Abínibí àti Àwọn Àròfọ̀ Mìíràn the pages examined are: pp 1-50 (2026), pp 51-83 (2027), pp 84-116 (2028), pp 117-152 (2029), pp 153-216 (2030).

subtopics.name: Ogún Ọmọdé (Ìṣọlá, A., 2023) — Written Prose (Ìtàn Àròsọ)
objectives: demonstrate good knowledge of ideas in the work of art
draw moral lessons from the text
identify the narrative techniques in the text
identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the text

subtopics.name: Èdè Abínibí àti Àwọn Àròfọ̀ Mìíràn (Àdéwọlé, O., 2023) — Poetry (Ewì)
objectives: deduce the import of written works of art and genres
identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the poem

subtopics.name: Ọ̀tẹ̀ Oyè (Fádíyà, O., 2023) — Drama (Eré Onítàn)
objectives: identify the central theme of the work
interpret the central theme in accordance with acceptable principles of the society
identify types of drama
identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the drama
extract the narrative techniques in the drama

subtopics.name: Èrò àti Ìgbàgbọ́ (Olódùmarè, àkùdàáyà, emèrè, àjẹ́, àwọn irúnmọlẹ̀, abbl.)
objectives: distinguish traditional practices and acceptable ways of life from modern and common sense beliefs

subtopics.name: Ètò Ìṣèlú àti Ààbò Ìlú (ẹgbẹ́ àti ọgbà, oyè jíjẹ àti àwọn ìjòyè, ogun jíjà, abbl.)
objectives: assess the functions and roles of individuals, chieftains, and groups in ensuring peace, stability and continuity of society

subtopics.name: Ètò Ìsìnkú àti Ogún Pínpín (òkú àgbà, òkú ọmọdé, òkú òòṣà, ìtúfọ̀, ìdí igi, abbl.)
objectives: distinguish between traditional practices
relate them to funerals and inheritance

subtopics.name: Òǹkà Yorùbá (oókan títí dé ọ̀kẹ́ kan, 1-20,000)
objectives: count in Yorùbá numerals
apply addition, deduction and division methods in Yorùbá

subtopics.name: Ètò Ìgbéyàwó àti Ìsọmọlórúkọ
objectives: relate social activities and events to appropriate situations

subtopics.name: Ètò Ìwòsàn (ìtọ́jú aláìsàn, ìtọ́jú àti ìgbẹ̀bí aboyún, abbl.)
objectives: demonstrate knowledge of the best way of using the appropriate health care practices

subtopics.name: Eré Ìdárayá (eré òṣùpá: àlọ́, bojúbojú; eré ojúmọmọ: ìjàkadì, ayò, òkòtó, àrín, abbl.)
objectives: identify types of Yorùbá traditional games
identify rules and regulations guiding each game
mention values derived from each game

subtopics.name: Iṣẹ́ Abínibí àti Oúnjẹ Ilẹ̀ Yorùbá (iṣẹ́-àgbẹ̀, ìṣọnà, ìlù lílù; oúnjẹ: àbàrí, iyán, ẹ̀wà, abbl.)
objectives: demonstrate adequate knowledge of the various traditional professions
compare various traditional professions
demonstrate knowledge of preparing each type of Yorùbá food
mention nutritional values of each food

subtopics.name: Ẹ̀kọ́ Ilé (Ìwà ọmọlúàbí àti àǹfààní rẹ̀)
objectives: identify acceptable patterns of behaviour and attitude that conform with societal norms and values
